metadata.title: Storage Integrity & Immutability Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines how storage platforms preserve the integrity, consistency, and trustworthiness of data over time, preventing unauthorized modification, rollback, or deletion regardless of application, automation, or operational behavior.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability responsible for ensuring institutional data assets remain trustworthy, auditable, and compliant with regulatory and legal obligations.

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability concerned with preserving recoverability and continuity of critical information assets.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Persistent storage platforms responsible for data durability and protection.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Technologies providing backup, snapshot, and archival storage capabilities.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes immutable and integrity-preserving storage services as a foundational platform capability.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Institutional records that must remain complete, authentic, and non-repudiable.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data preserved to support audits, investigations, and legal discovery.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Data whose integrity is tied to legal, regulatory, or contractual obligations.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines requirements for persistent protection, integrity assurance, and evidentiary traceability in a data-centric security architecture.

components.title: Immutability Enforcement
components.description: Prevents modification or deletion of protected data once written, regardless of user, application, or automation intent.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Impact-stage attacks aim to destroy or corrupt data to deny availability or erase evidence.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Data destruction and inhibition of recovery are core ransomware objectives.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Uses write-once or append-only protections to prevent tampering.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Storage mechanisms prevent unauthorized modification or destruction.
Immutable backups and recovery copies are protected against alteration.

components.title: Snapshot and Versioning Guarantees
components.description: Provides verifiable recovery points through time-consistent snapshots and versioning that cannot be silently altered or rolled back.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Attackers frequently attempt to sabotage backups and recovery points.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Inhibition of system recovery targets backup and snapshot mechanisms.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Maintains historical versions to enable trusted rollback and recovery.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Recovery mechanisms support restoration to known-good states.
Snapshots and versions are preserved to support recovery objectives.

components.title: Integrity Verification and Tamper Evidence
components.description: Detects unauthorized modification through cryptographic checks and tamper-evident metadata.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Defense evasion often involves subtle or silent data modification.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Secret and metadata manipulation can mask unauthorized changes.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Uses cryptographic integrity checks to detect tampering.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity checks detect unauthorized data changes.
Cryptographic mechanisms ensure message and data integrity.

components.title: Forensic Preservation Compatibility
components.description: Ensures data and metadata remain suitable for forensic analysis, legal proceedings, and regulatory review.

props.name: attack-tactics
props.remarks: Attackers attempt to erase traces after causing damage.

props.name: attack-techniques
props.remarks: Indicator and log removal undermines investigations.

props.name: defensive-techniques
props.remarks: Preserves evidentiary data and metadata for investigation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Incident-related data is preserved to support analysis.
Audit and evidence data are protected from modification.
Forensic-relevant data is retained for accountability.
